Tap a surface point to inspect ζ(s).
The surface height is the true |ζ(s)|, not a logarithmic scale. Heights from 15 to 25 fade for display. Small rings mark zeros; the pole at s = 1 rises beyond the visible surface. In Ground view: drag to look, pinch/scroll to travel, double-tap to move. In Overview: drag to orbit and pinch/scroll to zoom.
